proof_id_hash.description: Identifier hash of the proof that was registered.

issuer_address.description: Issuer address authorized for the registered proof.

schema_version.description: Approved schema version associated with this proof.

created_ledger.description: Ledger sequence at which the proof was registered.

created_at.description: Ledger timestamp at which the proof was registered.

expires_at.description: Ledger timestamp at which the proof expires.

epoch.description: Registry epoch after this registration committed. A cache or indexer may invalidate on this value alone instead of diffing individual records.

description: Published once a proof registration commits with its issuer, schema, creation and expiry timing, and registry epoch. The commitment is omitted and must be read back with get_proof.
